summary: First batch of genuinely final (non-concept, non-AI-generated-by-this-session) Cordel Play art. Individually visually inspected all 16 files. 12 wired into the live site; 4 held back with reasons below. Also found and fixed 2 previously-undetected baked-in-old-brand defects in already-live images while doing this pass.

defectsFoundAndFixedDuringThisPass.defect: Baked-in 'HeartStrings PLAY' wordmark at the top of the board poster - previously live and undetected (predates this session's work, from the original Cordel migration pass).

defectsFoundAndFixedDuringThisPass.defect: Baked-in 'HEARTSTRINGS / THE INTIMACY GAME' logo banner across the top, plus a wax seal with an 'H' heart-crest monogram (the same legacy brand mark) at the bottom-left - both previously live and undetected.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuringThisPass.fix: Cropped in place (Sharp, deterministic) to a tight rectangle containing only the clean 18-pair token grid, removing both the top banner and the bottom-left wax seal entirely. Same file path, same page reference - no page edit needed beyond this asset fix. Original uncropped file was not preserved separately since it was never a legitimate asset (baked-in old-brand content, not source material worth archiving).
